App.Description: PowerShell 7, the cross-platform shell. Runs side by side with Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Command-line tool (az) for managing Azure resources.
Python 3.12 runtime. Needed to install Prowler.

Module.Name: Az
Module.Description: Azure PowerShell - cmdlets for managing Azure resources.

Module.Name: Microsoft.Graph.Authentication
Module.Description: Sign-in and request cmdlets for Microsoft Graph (used by Maester).

Module.Name: Pester
Module.Description: PowerShell test framework. Maester runs its tests with it.

Module.Name: Maester
Module.Description: Test framework for Entra ID, Conditional Access and Microsoft 365 security.

Module.Name: PSRule
Module.Description: Rules engine used by PSRule for Azure.

Module.Name: PSRule.Rules.Azure
Module.Description: Well-Architected Framework rules for Azure resources.

Module.Name: WARA
Module.Description: Well-Architected Reliability Assessment collector from Microsoft.

Module.Name: ImportExcel
Module.Description: Create Excel files without Excel installed (used by ARI).

Module.Name: AzureResourceInventory
Module.Description: Azure Resource Inventory - Excel inventory and network diagram.

Module.Name: AzAPICall
Module.Description: Azure API helper module used by Azure Governance Visualizer.
